get_state.doc: PMF survey gate for the FE popup/timer. Returns { done, snooze_until } — done=1 when the user already responded (profile flag OR survey_response row), snooze_until=unix ts of an active 'remind later'.

submit.doc: Upsert the caller's survey response (one row per user). score=1-5 stars; answers=JSON string of the PMF wizard (optional — the score-only submit fires when 'Take the survey' is clicked, before the wizard completes). Sets profile.survey.done=1.

dismiss.doc: 'Remind me later' — sets profile.survey.snooze_until = now + 7 days. The popup/timer stays silent until then.
